passes.description: Unlocks the premium track of the Moon Pass: nine exclusive cosmetics, including the Midnight Gala Blade at tier 30. Tiers you've already reached unlock at once.
passes.name: Moon Pass Premium

passes.description: The Royal Rapier blade, the Gilded Lantern Blaster and the Golden Confetti knockout effect.
passes.name: Royal Masquerade Set

passes.description: A glowing pink and cyan Phantom blade. Looks only: it tags like every other blade.
passes.name: Neon Nightmare Blade

passes.description: A navy and gold Guardian blaster that fires a golden beam. Looks only.
passes.name: Starfall Blaster

passes.description: A shining golden sun mask with glowing rays.
passes.name: Golden Sun Mask

passes.description: A trail of green ghostfire that follows you as you run.
passes.name: Ghostfire Trail

passes.description: Entry to the VIP lounge on the plaza's balcony, a gold VIP tag in chat and a gold name over your head in the lobby.
passes.name: VIP Lounge

passes.description: Five extra emotes for the lobby and rounds: Spotlight, Confetti Cannon, Glitter Puff, Star Halo and Applause. Looks only.
passes.name: Party Emotes

place.description:
Welcome to the masked ball! Every round, one guest is secretly the Phantom, and only you know your own role.

🎭 PHANTOM: tag the guests before time runs out, and don't get caught.
🌙 GUARDIAN: find the Phantom and knock them out with the Moonbeam Blaster.
💖 MEDIC: revive a tagged guest, who saw who tagged them!
💡 SABOTEUR: cut the lights and help the Phantom.
🎉 GUEST: grab candy coins and clue pages to ring the Truth Bell, which shows where the Phantom is hiding.

🏰 Two huge maps: Hollowmere Manor and the Starlight Carnival, with secret passages, a mirror maze and a ferris wheel.
🎁 Collect over 60 masks, blades, blasters, knockout effects and trails. Open crates with coins you earn, trade with friends, and climb the Moon Pass.
💬 Whisper close by: in a round, only people near you can hear you.

Cartoon knockouts, no blood. Have fun, and trust no one!
